idea: Gas pressure is particles hitting the walls: heating them speeds them up and squeezing them into less room makes them hit more often, so P = nRT/V.

parameters.name: temperature
parameters.why: From a very cold gas to a hot one; zero kelvin would stop every particle.

parameters.name: volume
parameters.why: From a third to the whole of the box, so the piston always fits on the stage.

moves: Particles fly about the box and bounce off the walls and the piston; they speed up when the gas is heated and crowd together when the piston moves in.
steps: Hotter gas hits harder and more often
